title: Crystal Pear Ear Cuff
descriptionHtml:
One clear pear, no piercing needed. An ear cuff of slim polished gold wire that slides onto the middle ridge of the ear, carrying one clear pear cut stone in gold claws. Wear it alone or with the Emerald Square Ear Cuff.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the Emerald Square Ear Cuff on the same ear.

Details

  • Style: Ear cuff, no piercing needed
  • Size: Approximately 12mm across
  • Stone: One pear cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 7mm, in gold claws
  • Fit: Slides onto the middle ridge of the ear
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
